# Results summary (simulated data)

These results come from 80 simulated students (960 student-topic rows, 31% labelled
"requires attention"), generated by the rules in `simulation_rules.md`. They show that the pipeline works on data with
known learning patterns. They are not evidence about real students.

**Rule baseline.** Flags a topic when the student's last score on it was below 50%. It needs no training and uses
one number. Across 5-fold cross-validation it reached accuracy 0.68, precision 0.49,
recall 0.54 and F1 0.51.

**Logistic Regression.** Weighs all six features in a straight line after putting them on the same scale. It reached
accuracy 0.77, precision 0.68, recall 0.48 and F1 0.56. The features with the
largest weights were the average score on the topic, the days since the topic was last studied and the last score on the topic.

**Random Forest.** Combines 300 decision trees, so it can pick up thresholds and interactions a straight line misses. It
reached accuracy 0.75, precision 0.63, recall 0.45 and F1 0.53. It relied most on
the average score on the topic, then the days since the topic was last studied and the minutes studied.

**What the app uses.** The app averages the two models' probabilities to rank topics. On the hold-out test set that
average reached accuracy 0.78, precision 0.68, recall 0.49 and F1 0.57.

**Reading the comparison.** The best F1 was Logistic Regression. Both models were more accurate and more precise than the rule (when they flag a topic they are right more often). The rule caught as many or more of the truly weak topics (recall), at the cost of more false alarms. The models also use study time and recency, which lets the app rank topics and explain each recommendation. Whether the models beat the rule on real students is the main question for future work.

## 5-fold cross-validation, mean ± standard deviation (simulated data)

| Model | Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rule baseline (last score < 50%) | 0.684 ± 0.023 | 0.488 ± 0.037 | 0.541 ± 0.047 | 0.512 ± 0.031 |
| Logistic Regression | 0.770 ± 0.009 | 0.678 ± 0.029 | 0.476 ± 0.029 | 0.559 ± 0.021 |
| Random Forest | 0.752 ± 0.011 | 0.633 ± 0.020 | 0.452 ± 0.035 | 0.527 ± 0.029 |

## What each model relies on (simulated data)

| Feature | LR coefficient (standardised) | RF importance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mean_score | -1.332 | 0.426 |
| last_score | 0.225 | 0.118 |
| attempt_count | 0.001 | 0.037 |
| session_count | 0.013 | 0.073 |
| total_minutes | -0.16 | 0.151 |
| days_since_last_studied | 0.228 | 0.195 |
